{'translated': 'Last month, reports indicated that Apple was developing a brand-new AI shopping assistant for the Apple Store app on iPhone and iPad.'}

{'translated': 'It now appears that Apple is rolling out this feature to some users in the form of an "early preview".'}

{'translated': 'Within the Apple Store app, some users can now see a new chat-style icon in the bottom right corner, replacing the traditional search icon. On that page, users can search for products or start a conversation with a "virtual shopping assistant".'}

{'translated': 'Suggested prompts include:'}

  • {'translated': 'The latest Apple products'}
  • {'translated': 'Check my trade-in value'}
  • {'translated': 'Explain carrier deals'}
  • {'translated': 'Help me choose a watch'}
  • {'translated': 'iPhone monthly instalment plans'}
  • {'translated': 'Compare iPad lineups'}

{'translated': 'The images above were provided by ShrimpApplePro on X, giving us a preview of the new design.'}

{'translated': "Apple's fine print states:"}

{'translated': 'Not everyone will have access to the shopping assistant within the Apple Store app. Apple says it is making it available to a limited number of users in an "early preview", but has not said when it will be expanded to all users.'}

{'translated': 'What do you think of Apple adding this brand-new AI assistant to the Apple Store app? Would you use it? Drop us a comment below.'}
